name: EPIC 248876023

text.card: A red giant 3,528 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.83 solar masses and 12.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,466 K at its surface.
